title.zh: Ondo unlocks BlackRock portfolio strategies, but only non-US traders benefit
title.en: Ondo unlocks BlackRock portfolio strategies, but only non-US traders benefit

current_state.zh: Ondo Finance launched three tokenized portfolio tokens (BLKHIon, BLKDIGon, BLKGRWon) built on BlackRock-developed strategies, but they are Ondo-issued securities rather than BlackRock fund interests, and direct redemption is limited to onboarded non-US investors.
